messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a weird failure on the long-context suite for the new quantized-1.8 build. Lots of partial instruction drops near session boundaries.

eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=redwood-q1.8 | suite=long-context-v2 | pass=74/120 | regressions=6 | top-failure=prompt-truncation+instr-loss | details: https://ci.internal/runs/2015/longctx/1234

cheng: ugh. can you paste a sample generation?

maya: here's one (shortened):

```
USER: Use the following rules, then answer.
1) Summarize the doc
2) Then provide step-by-step plan

MODEL: [starts well] ... then after token ~2048 the model repeats context and drops the explicit instruction list. output ends with partial sentence.
```

maya: it looks like the beginning of the instruction set is in the KV but after a session rotation we get repeated tokens and the instruction list is effectively lost.

cheng: can we correlate with prefix eviction logs? which hosts had this?

maya: from the run logs: shard-3 and shard-7 show eviction events around the same time. excerpt:

```
[2026-03-17T02:14:52Z] shard-3: prefix_evict idx=4912 reason=slot_overflow
[2026-03-17T02:14:53Z] shard-7: kv_rotate start session_id=0x7fffe8
[2026-03-17T02:14:53Z] shard-3: kv_apply rotation_offset=10240
```

tom: is this the quantization branch only? or also reproducible on fp16?

maya: fp16 nightly shows smaller headroom but no instruction drops in the same prompt set. quantized-1.8 seems to hit a boundary where cached offsets wrap and the stitch code doesn't remap some token positions -> grafted repeats.

nina: do we have a minimal repro script? I can try local reproduce on dev-gpu.

maya: yes, repro steps:
1) run ./tools/run_longctx_eval --model redwood-q1.8 --seq 8192 --session-window 10240 --promptset long-instr-200
2) tail -f /var/log/redwood/serving/shard-*/kv-*.log
3) look for prefix_evict + kv_rotate within 1s of generation start

cheng: thanks. i'll try to reproduce on shard-sim with the same rotation cadence. if I can get logs, next step is to add extra assertions in the stitcher to detect unmapped offsets.

tom: also log the per-token KV index mapping. if stitcher sees a gap it should fall back to re-request prefix from storage rather than emit repeat. sound right?

maya: yep. also flagging that the nightly eval aggregator should tag this as a longctx-kv-staleness issue (so it won't get mixed with prompt-parsing bugs).

eval-bot: note added: tag=longctx-kv-staleness by maya at 2026-03-17T02:25:10Z

nina: i'll try repro locally in ~30m and report back. if I can reproduce, i'll attach a small trace and a trimmed prompt.

cheng: assigning to @tom and @nina for a quick mitigation PR: add a conservative remap check + extra logging around rotation boundary. set priority=P1 for nightly stability. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. keep updates minimal here so notif noise stays low. if you hit a reproducible test case, paste it into the eval tracker.

nina: reproduced on dev-gpu-2. attaching snippet in tracker (will add link when upload done).
